expected_deliverable: A tested host-neutral adapter layer in which tmux remains explicitly authoritative, Herdr discovery is deterministic and ambiguity-rejecting, Herdr prompt delivery cannot occur, Opsle wake requests remain durable/backward-compatible, and the provider-free dispatcher has no queue-check/subscription lost-wakeup window.

old tmux wake requests remain readable and byte-identical

objective: Implement a host-neutral SupervisorHostAdapter boundary, deterministic read-only Herdr discovery/status, Opsle-owned host bindings and wake targets, and a provider-free no-lost-wakeup dispatcher ordering fix while keeping tmux authoritative and making Herdr prompt delivery fail closed because installed Herdr 0.8.2 cannot prove an empty human composer or exclusive input transaction.
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
prohibited_actions: Herdr live prompt testing or PTY injection
PR merge, deployment, server-wide install, or foreign repository initialization
relevant_context: The original tmux-hosted supervisor-1005d601-4da1-4f6b-a7fa-f0b71dedabbe generation 9 is the sole live and authoritative supervisor; the operator manually closed the temporary duplicate Herdr Codex workspace while leaving the Herdr server running.

Accepted audit decision decision-485d74ab-b337-4267-8372-1d9b153125a6 establishes Herdr 0.8.2 protocol 20 as NO-GO for automated adoption because its prompt API is PTY transport without atomic prompt-idle, draft-empty, concurrent-input exclusion, generation fencing, request deduplication, or Opsle receipt coupling.

Herdr is operationally superior for structured workspaces, pane/process identity, agent status, server persistence, event subscriptions, sidebar, and remote/multi-client attach; preserve these as structured observations, not delivery authorization.

The prior tmux dispatcher attempt is durably rejected; its immutable events and wake requests must remain unchanged. Current source is useful unaccepted work that must be corrected, not treated as proven.
The current dispatcher checks a receipt-free queue before watcher registration, creating a lost-wakeup gap. Register observation first, recheck the queue, then block provider-free.
Old wake request schemas and exact hashes are immutable evidence. Compatibility must be additive and must not rewrite them.
Graphify was not selected for this narrow source slice; do not invoke it.
